title: Refs KS-2182: tests/connectors moves from jest to Vitest (root test:connectors script and root vitest devDependency)
body:
Refs KS-2182
Refs KS-1398

Ticket: https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-2182/ks-1398-step-one-l2b-testsconnectors-moves-from-jest-to-vitest-root

## What this changes

KS-1398 step one, lane L2b (TypeScript 7 preparation). `Blockchain/Dev/tests/connectors/` ran on Jest through ts-jest, which cannot run on TypeScript 7 (the measure-and-plan report: 220 of 220 originate suites fail with "does not expose the JavaScript compiler API required by ts-jest"). This PR moves the connector smoke suite to Vitest 4.1.12, which already runs on TypeScript 5.9.3 and 7.0.2 in this repository. It adds `tests/connectors/vitest.config.ts`, removes `tests/connectors/jest.config.cjs`, edits two lines of the root `package.json`, regenerates the root `package-lock.json` by a measured additive set, and adds a docs fragment pair. It changes no TypeScript version, no workspace manifest, no standalone lock, no `src/` file and none of the 20 `*.test.ts` files (`git diff --stat` shows 0 lines on them). Nothing publishes anything.

Each of these is its own item:

1. **Root `vitest` devDependency (`^4.1.12`).** The root `package.json` declared no test runner: `test:connectors` resolved `jest` and `ts-jest` only by hoisting from workspaces, and `vitest` already sat in the root lock the same way (25 workspaces declare it at `^4.1.9` to `^4.1.12`). The root now declares it, so the script no longer depends on a workspace. `test:connectors` is `vitest run --root tests/connectors` (it was `jest --config tests/connectors/jest.config.cjs`).
2. **24 additive optional entries in the root lock.** Adding the line makes npm complete rollup's optional platform binaries: 24 `@rollup/rollup-*` entries at 4.60.4 (all `optional: true`) are added; the root `""` entry gains the `vitest` line; 0 entries removed, 0 changed otherwise. Text diff of the lock: 352 added, 0 removed lines. Advisory read over the 24 (the registry's bulk endpoint): 0 advisories (control `js-yaml 3.13.0`: 6).
3. **`tests/connectors/jest.config.cjs` removed with `git rm`** in this commit (granted for this lane only; git history keeps it). A dangling Jest config beside a Vitest one invites someone to run the dead runner. The `!`-in-path note it carried is kept as a comment in `vitest.config.ts`.
4. **Type-check loss, stated rather than hidden.** Under Jest the files were compiled by ts-jest with diagnostics on; under Vitest they are transformed by esbuild with no type check. No tsconfig covers `tests/connectors` today (`check:test-types` lists five services only), so no existing gate changes. `@types/jest`, which gives editors the `describe` and `test` globals today, is removed by L3's last round (a candidate filing, not part of this PR).
5. **Vite config-loader warning on Node v26.8.1.** A `.ts` config in a package with no `"type"` field can print "(!) Your Vite config uses features that are unsupported by `configLoader: 'native'`". Measured: 1 such line in a scratch install that resolved Vite 8.3.8; 0 lines in this worktree, which resolves the repository's hoisted Vite 7.3.7. rc 0 and the counts are unaffected in both. A `.mts` config prints none (scratch).
6. **Merge slot:** root-manifest slot 1, root-lock slot 2: this PR merges after L1 (merged) and AHEAD of L2a (L2a regenerates the root lock on top of it); it must merge BEFORE L3's final round, because `test:connectors` resolves jest by hoisting today.
7. **Not covered:** a credentialed run (every test is a placeholder that asserts `true`, so a green run with credentials proves nothing about a connector, as `docs/CONNECTORS_PATTERN.md` already says); Node 24; a container build; and `docs/CONNECTORS_PATTERN.md:194`, whose note says the 20 files use Jest and goes stale on merge (not changed here; a candidate filing).
8. **Docs:** one fragment per page (`Projects Documents/fragments/{flow,cheat}/KS-2182-tests-connectors-vitest.html`).

## Test Evidence

Develop `581296f039b4`, branch cut on it. TypeScript 5.9.3 in the tree; Node v26.8.1 (not an LTS line) and npm 11.19.0; Darwin 27.2.0 arm64, shared with other sessions; 2026-11-12 (UTC).

**Touched:** `git diff --stat` (three-dot): 6 files, 444 insertions, 24 deletions. `Blockchain/Dev/package.json` (2 added, 1 removed), `Blockchain/Dev/package-lock.json` (352 added, 0 removed), `Blockchain/Dev/tests/connectors/jest.config.cjs` (removed, 23 lines), `Blockchain/Dev/tests/connectors/vitest.config.ts` (new, 32 lines) and the two fragment files. No workspace manifest, no standalone lock.

**Ran (from the Dev root of this worktree, the real path under `!CODING`; each pair is before = develop, after = this branch):**

| Check | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `npm run test:connectors` | rc 0: `Test Suites: 16 skipped, 4 passed, 4 of 20 total`; `Tests: 17 skipped, 5 passed, 22 total` | rc 0: `Test Files  4 passed \| 16 skipped (20)`; `Tests  5 passed \| 17 skipped (22)` |
| `npm run check:connectors` | rc 0: `[check-connectors] PASS: 21 connectors, 20 test files, 12 active md rows.` | same line, rc 0 |
| `npm run test:connectors -- smtp-email` | rc 0: 1 suite skipped, 2 tests skipped | rc 0: `Test Files  1 skipped (1)`; `Tests  2 skipped (2)` |
| root lock, `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts` | control with no manifest change: rc 0, lock byte-identical (sha256 prefix `a9841ec02e8aa2e0`) | rc 0; 1,931 to 1,955 entries; 1 changed, 24 added, 0 removed; second run byte-equal to the first (`4c9b79f679166c37`); equal to the scratch candidate |
| `npm ci --dry-run --ignore-scripts` (Dev root) | n/a | rc 0, lock unchanged |
| `npm run audit:gate` | rc 0: `audit-gate: 5 distinct advisories reported, 5 baselined.` then `OK — no advisories outside the triaged baseline.` | same two lines, rc 0 |
| `npm run audit:locks` | rc 0: `audit-locks: 44 standalone lockfiles (46 tracked, minus the Blockchain/Dev/package-lock.json workspace root which audit-gate covers, minus 1 declared out of scope = 46 - 1 - 1 = 44 ...)` then `OK — no standalone-lock advisories outside the triaged baseline.` | same, rc 0. It does NOT scan the root lock, by design (its own line): see below |
| `docs-fragments.mjs check` | n/a | OK (lint clean, render passes); a planted unclosed `<div>` turned it red (rc 1, "tags are not balanced"), restored by content and sha256, green again |

**Why `audit:gate` is the root-lock proof.** `audit:locks` excludes the root lock, so a vulnerable root-lock entry cannot make it fail: with `js-yaml 3.13.0` planted in a scratch copy of the new root lock it still read rc 0 and `OK`. `audit:gate` (`npm audit` at the Dev root against the baseline) read rc 0 on the new pair (5 distinct, 5 baselined) and rc 1 on the planted copy (11 distinct, 6 new). Both ran in a scratch checkout of develop with the repository's own scripts.

**Planted controls that fired (each in a scratch COPY, never this worktree):** the first of the 2 `expect(true).toBe(true)` in `mock-kyc.test.ts` made false: rc 1 through `npm run test:connectors` itself and through the bare binary (`Test Files  1 failed | 3 passed | 16 skipped (20)`; `Tests  1 failed | 4 passed | 17 skipped (22)`), and rc 1 on Jest (`1 failed, 16 skipped, 3 passed`); `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=x` un-skips exactly one suite (`5 passed | 15 skipped` files, `6 passed | 16 skipped` tests; Jest: the same); a decoy test outside the directory is NOT run by the shipped script (20 files), while the shape without `--root` (`--config tests/connectors/vitest.config.ts` from the Dev root) ran 21 files, decoy included; a wrong expected count in the re-key tool was refused rc 2.

**TypeScript 7.0.2 in a scratch clone (a measurement, not a gate; nothing installed in this tree):** `typescript@7.0.2` installed beside Vitest 4.1.12 with `--save-exact --legacy-peer-deps --ignore-scripts`; the same `npm run test:connectors`: rc 0, `4 passed | 16 skipped (20)`, `5 passed | 17 skipped (22)`.

**Deploy check (read-only, from git objects at `581296f039b4`):** Dockerfiles repo-wide 37 (35 under `Blockchain/Dev`); 172 COPY/ADD sources read against the build contexts of the 15 compose files: 0 exact and 0 wide root-pair hits (controls: a self-test plants `COPY package*.json ./` and `COPY . .` and the detector fires on both; 47 `services/<x>/package*` sources are found). Workflows, preflight scripts and `.githooks`: 0 calls to `test:connectors`. ONE workflow step installs at the Dev root: `.github/workflows/deploy-demo.yml:122-123` (`working-directory: Blockchain/Dev`, `npm ci`, job `build-app`). It is gated by the input `i_know_this_is_the_legacy_container_apps_path` (declared at line 35): `build-app` carries `if: github.event.inputs.i_know_this_is_the_legacy_container_apps_path == 'true'` (line 106), a `legacy-guard` job (lines 54 to 61) fails unless it is `true`, and the workflow is `workflow_dispatch` only; it targets the deleted Container Apps estate. The gate tier was ruled 2 on that evidence.

**Open PRs (GraphQL census at the cut: 102 open; controls: PR 2125 names `services/api-gateway/src/index.ts`, PR 2099 names the root lock):** none names `tests/connectors/`; the root `package.json` is named by 1 (945, dependabot); the root lock by 11 (575, 635, 639, 649, 945, 946, 947, 948, 949, 1965 dependabot, and 2099), all waived by name for this lane. `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head: develop clean; 2099 clean; the clean dependabot PRs 635, 639, 945, 946, 947, 1965; conflicts with 575, 649, 948 and 949, each of which already conflicts with develop alone (so this PR newly conflicts with none). A planted control (a scratch commit editing the line 945 changes) conflicted with 945 (rc 1).

**NOT run / not covered:** unit tests of any other package (nothing outside `tests/connectors`, the two root files and the two fragments changed: see `git diff --stat`); the four platform suites (Schemathesis, Akto, Playwright, k6); a credentialed connector run; Node 24 (the project's LTS line); a container build; type-checking of these test files (see item 4). This is a form change that runs on Jest's replacement on TypeScript 5.9.3 and, in scratch, 7.0.2; it is not a proven cure for the step-five version flip.

**Develop moved after the cut** (581296f039b4 to cea1cdc2b07d, 2 commits, 3 files in `services/originate` and `services/transfer`): this branch's base is an ancestor of it; exact overlap with this PR's 6 paths 0; no `package.json`, no lock and nothing under `tests/connectors` in the move; `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head with it: rc 0, and the root `package.json`, root lock and `vitest.config.ts` in the merged tree are equal to this commit's. The lock simulation and `audit:gate` were not re-run on the merged tree (the root pair is identical); I did not merge develop in or push again.

**Migrations and config:** none. No environment variable, no workspace manifest, no standalone lock.

**Pre-push hook:** Two pushes. FIRST (05:13 to 05:29 UTC, 951 s) was REFUSED at leg 14 and nothing reached origin: "shell suites: 126 passed, 1 failed, 0 skipped (of 127)", "FAILED: Blockchain/Dev/scripts/__tests__/start_secuura_marker_unknown_warning.test.sh", "PREFLIGHT FAILED on leg(s) 14 - fix the above before pushing. (13/16 legs ran)". That suite's own text is a "printf: write error: Broken pipe" at its line 49 followed by FAIL on its lease-line control. It reads none of this PR's paths, is byte-identical to develop's copy, and passed 20 of 20 runs in this worktree and 20 of 20 in a pristine develop checkout; the failing line pipes a 33 KB script into `grep -q` under `pipefail` with the match 1,177 bytes before the end, a timing race of a known class, not proven in the hook's environment. I did not edit it and did not bypass the hook. SECOND push (05:45 to 06:00 UTC, 882 s) VERIFIED, `ls-remote` equal to this head: "shell suites: 127 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (of 127)", then "PREFLIGHT INCOMPLETE — 13/16 legs ran, 3 SKIPPED. Nothing failed." Legs 3, 4 and 8 were skipped (the local stack was not up). Leg 1 OK (spec in sync); legs 6 and 7 OK (the audit gate and the standalone-lock audit); leg 16: five services, 0 new. This is not a pass; it says which legs ran.
